teaser: Why the AWS site is aws.twin.sgit.ai: a twin first, and one naming rule for every family of sites.
core_idea: The AWS site is named aws.twin.sgit.ai because it is designed twin first, an AWS-shaped interface on a vault with the live account as a second backend, and because every family of sites now follows one rule, plural for the hub and singular for the instance, which four existing hosts break and which needs DNS records rather than wildcard certificates on GitHub Pages.

nodes.summary: Interface on a vault; live account as a backend.

nodes.label: DNS, not certificates

nodes.summary: A live backend borrows the user's session.

quotes.text: The repositories are already right: every family repository uses the singular.
But these sites are on GitHub Pages, and there no wildcard certificate is needed.
